item.casualtinkering.circular_saw.descri: A versatile tool that functions as a hand axe for woodcutting and a melee weapon. Right-click to charge a spinning attack that damages enemies in a cone.
modifier.casualtinkering.circular_saw_at: Right-click to charge a spinning attack that damages enemies in a cone.
modifier.casualtinkering.magic_sword.des: When a fully charged melee attack lands, summons magical sword to strike the target. Higher levels summon more swords with increased total damage.
modifier.casualtinkering.magic_sword_con: Right-click and hold to charge, then release to summon magical swords to strike a target within 8 blocks. Higher levels summon more swords with increased total damage.
modifier.casualtinkering.magic_sword_aut: Automatically summons a magical sword to strike the nearest enemy within 9 blocks every few seconds. Higher levels reduce the cooldown and increase total damage.
modifier.casualtinkering.magic_sword_coo: When held in offhand, your mainhand attacks summon magical swords to assist. Higher levels summon more swords with increased total damage.
modifier.casualtinkering.thermal_ray.des: Consumes hot fluids to fire a devastating beam. Overheats after 10 shots.
